countries.rainfall_description_declared: Total precipitation aggregated over the time bucket within the admin polygon.
countries.population_description_declared: Population estimate for the admin unit derived from WorldPop annual population rasters for anchor years (2000, 2010, 2020). Annual values are linearly interpolated between anchors, backfilled before 2000 using 2000 values, and carried forward after 2020 using 2020 values. Annual estimates are expanded to monthly periods.
